verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Caveman is a skill invoked with /caveman, plus an open-source CLI that wraps agents. No documented one-line install command, package-manager install, or marketplace install is shown, and nothing says the skill becomes active in the next session. Invoking an already-installed skill and wrapping agents are adjacent capabilities, not the install experience this story asks about.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install a skill collection with one documented command — a package-manager one-liner, CLI, or in-agent marketplace command — and it is active in my next session
